label: era6-n1
_why: FIRST RUN OF THE RE-BANDED LADDER (ROADMAP step 1b, ruled 2026-08-12). The era anchors moved to 1750/1830/1870/1900/1925/1940 and every tier was placed by its own technology date, so most rungs dropped one era number. Seven invented ~1700 rungs were removed (they shared era 0 with a real ~1750 vanilla rung) and fifteen were added, filling every interior gap the re-band opened and giving era 5 real content. All fifteen now carry their own new technology, and the research-event emitter covers them: 53 new technologies (was 38), 137 covered by journal entries (was 122), 411 journal entries (was 366).
_arms: era6 = {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.era6.json}, research_events.enabled: true — the `techs+events` arm on the new ladder. n=1: this is a SHAKEDOWN of a structure that has never been in the game, not a measurement of a treatment.
_comparison: Against run002 of 20260812_093402_research-events-fixed-n2, which is the same arm (techs+events, fixed military gate, vanilla ahead-of-time penalty) on the OLD 100-tier ladder. ⚠ THE TWO DIFFER IN MORE THAN THE LADDER: 15 new technologies deepen the production tree, which raises the ahead-of-time penalty on everything above them, and 15 more journal entries exist to be filled. This run cannot separate 'the re-band' from 'a deeper tree' and is not meant to.
_watch: First, that it RUNS: 106 tier buildings, 40 of them emitted for the first time, and a 1836 start converted onto a ladder whose era-0 rungs changed. Read error.log and the PM_TECH_REHAUL init marker before anything else. Then: whether the new rungs are ever BUILT (building_inventory by type — glass fibre, tracer tooling, plywood furniture, the three 1915 war rungs); era-5 technologies held by the tree leader at 1935, against 17/17 production and 15/15 military on the previous events run and 12/17 and 1/15 on the baseline; and whether the deeper tree slows the leader as the ahead-of-time penalty implies it should.
_caveats: The era-1 employment threshold (5000) is PROVISIONAL and unruled — the re-band put tiers at era 1 whose technology is not an era-1 freebie, and the emitter keys on our tier era, so a value was required to build at all. It continues the ruled x3 ladder downward. Also: building_cost is still null on the fifteen new rungs, so they fall back to the building-level required_construction rather than a solved payback figure.
